'''Sodoh Reddik''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] who won many battles during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. He established the [[Republic Hyperspace Armada]].
